```{r}
library(ggplot2)
library(tidyverse)
```

```{r}
partifarver <- c(
 "KF" = "#1A932E",
  "RV" = "#954FAD",
  "S" = "#E3000F",
  "SF" = "#C32026",
  "V" = "#00529F")
```
```{r}
Graf <- read_csv("Data/1971.csv")
Graf_long <- pivot_longer(Graf, cols = everything(), names_to = "Parti", values_to = "Mandater")
show_col_types=FALSE
```
```{r}
ggplot(Graf_long, aes(x = Parti, y = Mandater, fill = Parti)) +
  geom_col() +
  scale_fill_manual(values = partifarver) +
  labs(title = "1971",
       x = "Parti",
       y = "Mandater") +
  theme_minimal()
```
